authors: Claude experiment director (drafted for coordinator review; revised under Revision 1 of the coordinator decision; owner choices decided 2026-11-06, see extensions.owner_choices)
question: On two fresh, previously unmeasured public 28-bit prime-order curves, does the opt-in cache-line pair index and relation guard (layout=lines) reduce the complete verified wall time of the current 28-bit generic index-calculus incumbent (prime-abscissa size 407, mitm:negation_folded=1, targets walk) while preserving every counted operation?

claims.text: Every measured execution recovers and verifies the planted discrete logarithm, and replay reproduces every measured record.

The candidate and incumbent have identical complete counted cost on every paired workload and round, and agree record by record (warm-ups included) on the recovered logarithm, total_gae, every unpriced-operation count that ecbench band prices, and every phase's adds, doubles, scalar_mults and gae, apart from the native counters listed in the freeze with their reasons.
claims.if_supported: the layout changes native constants only; it is not a counted or asymptotic improvement
claims.if_not_supported: the candidate is not the same algorithmic work and no layout-only speed claim is admitted

claims.text: The cache-line layout lowers complete verified solve wall time relative to the frozen incumbent on the specified fp28 workload and hardware class, in each of two independent L2 sessions.
claims.if_supported: a scoped constant-factor native engineering speed-up in the generic-decomposition track at 28 bits (mitm:negation_folded=1,layout=lines against mitm:negation_folded=1, prime-abscissa:size=407, targets=walk, two fresh public fp28 curves, AMD c8a.2xlarge, the ea8e9ef7 executable, exactly identical counted GAE); a component speed-up reported outside tables A-C, not a counted, asymptotic, algebraic-track or rho-beating result, and not a result at fp20
claims.if_not_supported: no end-to-end wall speed-up is established for this candidate at fp28

claims.text: The counted companion session records the remaining counted distance to the matched rho.negation reference for the incumbent and the candidate, as counted S at 0, 0.1 and 1 GAE per unpriced native operation (AGENTS.md 5a band). Counted only: rho wall time is not a claim anywhere in version 6, and the layout experiment does not claim to close the gap.

hypotheses.statement: Replacing the incumbent hash-map pair index and repeat guard with fixed cache-line buckets reduces native lookup overhead enough to reduce the complete solve wall time at 28 bits, where the packed pair table (about 2 MiB) exceeds the 1 MiB of L2 per core of a c8a core and the walk target source probes the repeat guard on each trial (less often than stride-renew, so the guard contribution may be smaller; decision Revision 1, section 12.3).
hypotheses.mechanism: A miss scans one aligned cache line with no hashbrown control/bucket indirection; batched lanes can prefetch the pure home address. Table emission order, relation stream, linear algebra, recovery, and counted operations are unchanged.

predictions.minimum_effect: in each of two independent L2 sessions, both the A/A-corrected per-operation wall interval and the complete total-wall 95% interval lie wholly below 1, outside the A/A noise; coordinator prior (not a threshold): corrected ratio 0.90-0.99, probability about 0.45 that both sessions support; the prior is kept under targets=walk, with its lower end less likely, decision section 12.3

power.note: Each wall session has 2 curves x 8 targets x (1 warmup + 8 measured rounds) x 4 arms = 576 executions and 128 measured pairs per arm pair (v3 had 64); the qualification has 48 executions (2 targets x 4 arms x (1 warmup + 5 rounds), 10 A/A pairs) and the counted companion 576. Both independent sessions must separately put the 95% full-wall interval below 1. This is stricter than pooling and is intended to resolve a repeatable native constant effect, not a minimum percentage effect; sensitivity is bounded by the same-session A/A interval, which must lie inside [0.9,1.1]. Four thousand bootstrap resamples are used by the fixed native comparison. instances is 16 workloads per session; replicates 16 is 8 measured rounds in each of the 2 sessions; warmups 2 is 1 per session.

measurement.timed_primary_justification: The independent variable is a native memory representation whose intended effect is not represented by group-operation counts. Therefore complete wall time is the decisive metric, but only at L2 with same-session A/A correction, exact counted-cost parity, a positive timing control with a guaranteed direction (pc-fb2x), and two independent host epochs. Per-execution timeout_seconds 600 and order alternate_measured (the spec spelling of the interleaved order) apply to the qualification, wall and counted specs. The counted spec must use L2 because the pinned run-ecbench refuses any other isolation_required.

stopping_rules.rule: Qualification stage: run exactly one non-resumable job from launch-v6/request-qualification.json (spec-fp28-v6-qual.json: the four wall arms in the same order, one fresh non-scientific fp28 curve seed 2026110628111, 2 targets, 1 warmup + 5 measured rounds, L2, 2 targets x 4 arms x (1 + 5) = 48 executions and 10 A/A pairs; job deadline 900 s; roles incumbent baseline, incumbent-aa control, candidate candidate, pc-fb2x reference, so the launcher's admission compares pc-fb2x against incumbent-aa; decision section 12.1 and 12.2). It passes only if, read mechanically from the job's own files after the SHA256SUMS check: job-exit.json exit_code is 0 from a single pod; audit.json is OK with every execution verified and every replay identical; l2-gate.json has accepted true, every execution graded L2 or L3 and invalid_outcomes []; the minimum time.solve_wall_ns over all 48 executions is at least 5,000,000; and (finished_unix_ms - started_unix_ms) of session.json times 576/48 is at most 1,800,000 ms. No ecbench compare is run on the qualification and no per-arm wall statistic or ratio is computed or read until both scientific sessions have written job-exit.json; only the global minimum and the elapsed projection are evaluated. If any condition fails, version 6 stops before the scientific stage; the qualification is not retried except under the host-loss rule.

Scientific stage, conditional only on the qualification: submit exactly two independent wall jobs from launch-v6/request-session-1.json and request-session-2.json (spec-fp28-v6.json, byte-identical in both: 2 fresh curves x 8 targets x (1 warmup + 8 measured rounds) x 4 arms = 576 executions, 128 measured pairs per arm pair), run each once, and stop.

Counted companion: after both wall jobs have written job-exit.json, run exactly one job from launch-v6/request-counted.json (spec-fp28-v6-counted.json, 576 executions, isolation_required L2 only; roles incumbent baseline, candidate candidate, rho-neg reference, rho-neg-aa control; the rho executions are expected to be graded below L2, so exit 42 is expected), once. It is accepted if the audit is OK, every execution verified, every measured replay identical, invalid_outcomes [] and the input spec and build match the freeze; exit code 0, 42 or 43 are all accepted under those conditions. A counted-session failure does not change the wall verdict; it blocks the leaderboard validation gate and is reported. No wall field of this session is read or reported.

Host loss: a job that writes no job-exit.json is rerun once, whole, as the same request with the job name suffixed -r2 (infrastructure retry only). A job that wrote job-exit.json with a non-zero code is never rerun. The noise-rerun clause is NOT adopted (owner-decided 2026-11-06, decision section 12.4 choice 3: not adopted; its text stays in PROTOCOL-V6.md section 8 as a record only, and F7 is not run). Without a noise-rerun clause, one execution graded below L2 (exit 42), or any other non-zero wall-session exit, makes that session invalid_measurement and ends version 6; no scientific rerun is allowed.

No scientific retry, alternate seed, factor-base retuning, load-factor tuning, threshold change or selective host replacement after seeing a result. Any infrastructure or payload failure is retained, the affected session is invalid_measurement, and this version is not repeated within itself.

Budget: USD 5 ceiling for the qualification, both wall jobs, the counted job, host-loss reruns and failed attempts. The launch card records the actual c8a.2xlarge on-demand and Spot list prices; if the worst case of 5.25 node-hours plus CodeBuild could exceed USD 5 at those prices, return to the coordinator before launch.

invalidation_rules: any wrong answer, missing replay, mismatched source/binary/spec hash, unpaired run or non-identical candidate/incumbent counted cost invalidates the speed claim
any record-level parity mismatch between candidate and incumbent outside the native counters enumerated in the freeze invalidates the speed claim
any measured row below L2, any restored timing interval, fewer than five admitted pairs, or A/A interval not containing 1 inside [0.9,1.1] makes that session descriptive

the pc-fb2x positive control must be detected independently in both sessions: counted ops ratio above 1 and total_wall_ci95 lower bound above 1; a pc-fb2x counted ratio at or below 1 invalidates the design
any wall-session exit code other than 0 invalidates that session
a qualification elapsed-time projection above 1,800,000 ms, or a minimum qualification solve under 5,000,000 ns, stops version 6 before any scientific seed is used
a stage-only improvement or one successful session is not a full end-to-end speedup
the qualification and the counted companion are not candidate wall evidence and cannot be pooled with either wall session
failure of the single qualification terminates version 6 without dispatching the scientific jobs
a spec that fails run-ecbench's pre-check, or a wall or qualification job that exits 43, invalidates that job

decision_rule.text: C-wall is supported only if, in each of the two independent wall sessions, all of the following hold: ecbench verify --replay-all exits 0 with no wrong or unpaired row; ops.ratio_b_over_a == 1 and ops.ci95 == [1,1] for candidate against incumbent and the record-level parity of claim C-parity holds; wall.status is admitted and wall.pairs_below_level is 0 and the job exited 0; wall.aa_ci95 of the incumbent-against-candidate comparison (which must show aa_arms equal to {incumbent, incumbent-aa} and self_aa false) and wall.aa_ci95 of the job's control-comparison.json (pc-fb2x against incumbent-aa) are each non-null, contain 1 and lie within [0.9,1.1] (the direct incumbent against incumbent-aa comparison is a self-A/A, descriptive only); pc-fb2x against incumbent has ops.ratio_b_over_a > 1, wall.status admitted and wall.total_wall_ci95[0] > 1; and total_wall_ci95[1] < 1, corrected_ci95[1] < 1 and outside_noise is true. Otherwise the verdict is within_control_distribution, invalid_measurement, or inconclusive as mapped by analyze-v6.sh. The counted-session rule decides only the validation-gate inputs.
decision_rule.threshold: in each session: total_wall_ci95 upper < 1 and corrected_ci95 upper < 1 and outside_noise true; both aa_ci95 intervals (candidate comparison, control-comparison.json) contain 1 within [0.9,1.1]; pc-fb2x ops ratio > 1 and total_wall_ci95 lower > 1; exact ops ratio 1 and record-level parity
decision_rule.statistic: candidate/incumbent ratio of total solve wall and A/A-corrected ns per GAE, evaluated separately per session
decision_rule.interval: ecbench linearised paired t 95% intervals; 4,000 bootstrap resamples, seeds 2026110661 (candidate), 2026110662 (descriptive direct incumbent against incumbent-aa; no gate reads it), 2026110663 (positive)
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: total_wall_ratio and corrected_ratio, with reciprocal baseline/candidate speedup reported

inputs: two authenticated ecbench.session/v1 wall directories and one counted directory downloaded from their exact private S3 results URIs, after the SHA256SUMS, job-exit.json, input-spec.json and build-info.json checks
the control-comparison.json written by run-ecbench into each wall job's output directory (read for the A/A gate)
outputs: counted comparisons at w = 0, 0.1 and 1 and the 5a band

graphs: per-session candidate/incumbent total-wall and A/A-corrected ratios with 95% intervals, beside the A/A and the pc-fb2x positive control
phase contribution diagnostic with the full solve total emphasized
counted S of incumbent and candidate against matched rho.negation with the AGENTS.md 5a pricing band at w = 0, 0.1 and 1

inadmissible: changing seeds, curve, targets, base size, load factor, number of sessions, rounds, thresholds or analysis after observing data
calling a relation-phase or setup-only improvement a speedup
pooling only favorable sessions or discarding contention not excluded by the frozen L2 rule
claiming a counted, asymptotic, algebraic-track or rho-beating improvement from a native layout result, or any result at fp20
treating a successful Kubernetes job or private S3 receipt as a performance verdict without running the frozen analysis on authenticated raw records
dispatching either scientific job after a failed or unverified qualification
using consumed v1, v2, v3a1 or v5 jobs, the excluded fp20 local diagnostic, the v6 qualification or the v6 counted companion as a v6 performance sample
reading any qualification or counted-session wall field
reading the first session of a noise rerun before the rerun exits, if the owner adopts a noise-rerun clause
